item.title: Allergens (full list)
item.description: Allergens: 1. Gluten 2. Eggs 3. Fish 4. Peanuts 5. Crustaceans 6. Milk 7. Soy 8. Sesame 9. Nuts 10. Celery 11. Mustard 12. Lupine 13. Sulphur dioxide 14. Molluscs 15. Garlic

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu: A selection of fresh seasonal vegetables that you can combine with a protein of your choice to create your own meal salad.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu: Roasted aubergine in a rich, umami-packed aubergine pasta with penne, tomato and vegetables. Served with cheese and a fresh salad on the side. Also available gluten free. (1+2+6+10+11+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu: South African bobotie, baked lentils with pea protein, almonds and vegetables, served with rice and topped with a coconut egg custard, sprinkled with spring onion. Served with fruit chutney and South African sambal, a fresh salad much like pico de gallo, on the side. (2+6+9+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu: Okonomiyaki, Japanese pancake with pointed cabbage, miso and seaweed, served with kewpie mayonnaise and nori. (1+2+3+7+8+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu: Cannelloni filled with ricotta cream, spinach, palm kale, nutmeg and citrus, covered in a rich, full-bodied tomato sauce. (1+6)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu: Homemade falafel with tabbouleh salad and za'atar-spiced pita wedges. Served with a mezze of olives, hummus, tzatziki, pickled vegetables, chilli sauce, cabbage and red onion tossed in sumac, plus garlic dressing. Also available gluten free. (1+2+6+8+11+15)
